description: WRITE. Book a resource (e.g. a meeting room) for a member and/or company. Unless is_free or is_tentative is set, the booking is charged per the resource's rate, and the member is notified unless is_silent. Needs scope flex.space.bookings.create. OfficeRnD: POST /bookings.

company.description: The _id of the company the booking is for.

enforce_booking_policy.description: If true, apply member validations (business hours, durations, limits) and booking-policy approval flagging.

is_free.description: Mark as free — no fees are generated.

is_silent.description: If true, no notification is sent to the member.

member.description: The _id of the member the booking is for.

resource.description: The _id of the resource to book (see officernd_list_resources).

name: officernd_create_booking
title: Create a booking
